about: Place a Word file with endnotes (docxtext-c2): the references in the text, the bodies in a new endnote story on a new last page. Not covered: a text whose last paragraph ends with an endnote reference (InDesign wraps the endnote bodies in the reference character style and writes an empty character range in the closing paragraph; measured in docxtext2-en3.docx, goldens not kept).
